rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: So the Black Overman is here...
rows.display_text: 「So the Black Overman is here...」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Creepy place. Fitting home for a ghost of the Black History.
rows.display_text:
「Creepy place. Fitting home for a ghost
of the Black History.」

rows.speaker: Fa
rows.en: Huh... isn't that a colony from our world...?
rows.display_text:
「Huh... isn't that a colony from our
world...?」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: That's not all. Things flung here from all sorts of worlds have gathered in this place.
rows.display_text:
「That's not all. Things flung here from
all sorts of worlds have gathered in this
place.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Scars left by the destruction of space-time...
rows.display_text:
「Scars left by the destruction of
space-time...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: A wound from the past that can't be erased... Standing on this ground, those words come to mind.
rows.display_text:
「A wound from the past that can't be
erased... standing here, those words come
to mind.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Watch out! They're coming!
rows.display_text: 「Watch out! They're coming!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: What a number...!
rows.display_text: 「What a number...!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: So this is the Black Overman's personal escort force...!
rows.display_text:
「So this is the Black Overman's personal
escort force...!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Figures the Overdevil would show up too!
rows.display_text:
「Figures the Overdevil would show up
too!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: It's fine...! It's nowhere near as big as the one Kizz Munt had!
rows.display_text:
「It's fine...! It's nowhere near as big as
the one Kizz Munt had!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: But the black Overman isn't here.
rows.display_text: 「But the black Overman isn't here.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: It can't escape from this place. Once the escort force is taken down, it'll come out.
rows.display_text:
「It can't escape from this place. Once
the escort force is taken down, it'll come
out.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Then we know what to do! Let's drag it out here and now!
rows.display_text:
「Then we know what to do! Let's drag it
out here and now!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: (Gainer's sensing something...)
rows.display_text: （(Gainer's sensing something...)）

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: (Does Gainer know the black Overman's true identity...?)
rows.display_text:
（(Does Gainer know the black Overman's
true identity...?)）

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Then, to receive the guest of honor, I'll have to ask the attendants to step aside.
rows.display_text:
「Then, to receive the guest of honor,
I'll have to ask the attendants to step
aside.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Understood. Let's show the legacy of the Black History and the one who rules it what we're capable of.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. Let's show the Black
History's legacy and its ruler what we're
capable of.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: $c, all units, begin the attack! We'll wipe out the Executors!
rows.display_text:
「$c, all units, begin the attack! We'll
wipe out the Executors!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Let's go, everyone...! To bring this fight to an end!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, everyone...! To bring this
fight to an end!」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Yeah! I'm giving it everything I've got!
rows.display_text: 「Yeah! I'm giving it everything I've got!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I'm going all the way! Any machine that's no good for people, I'll smash it to pieces!
rows.display_text:
「I'm going all the way! Any machine
that's no good for people, I'll smash it
to pieces!」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: Let's go, everyone...! To bring this fight to an end!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, everyone...! To bring this
fight to an end!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: It's coming...!
rows.display_text: 「It's coming...!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: The Black Overman!
rows.display_text: 「The Black Overman!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: So it's finally shown itself!
rows.display_text: 「So it's finally shown itself!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: We're not letting you get away this time! First, you're gonna tell us what you're planning!
rows.display_text:
「Not letting you get away this time!
First, tell us what you're planning!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Pilot of the black Overman, I'll have you respond.
rows.display_text:
「Pilot of the black Overman, I'll have
you respond.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: It's ignoring us! Don't screw around!
rows.display_text: 「It's ignoring us! Don't screw around!」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: No, that's not it...
rows.display_text: 「No, that's not it...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: What do you mean, 'not it'? What's going on!?
rows.display_text:
「What do you mean, 'not it'? What's
going on!?」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: I can't sense any human presence from that Overman...!
rows.display_text:
「I can't sense any human presence from
that Overman...!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Is that also an unmanned unit equipped with the Executor System?
rows.display_text:
「Is that also an unmanned unit equipped
with the Executor System?」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: But... I can feel it. Some kind of will...
rows.display_text: 「But... I can feel it. Some kind of will...」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: This is...
rows.display_text: 「This is...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: People aren't the only ones with souls.
rows.display_text: 「People aren't the only ones with souls.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: That Overman's will... is that it?
rows.display_text: 「That Overman's will... is that it?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That's right.
rows.display_text: 「That's right.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Gainer...
rows.display_text: 「Gainer...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That Overman has a will... a soul dwelling inside it.
rows.display_text:
「That Overman has a will... a soul
dwelling inside it.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Gainer... you...
rows.display_text: 「Gainer... you...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: King Gainer told me. That Overman was calling out to it...
rows.display_text:
「King Gainer told me. That Overman was
calling out to it...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: No... that they'd been calling out to each other.
rows.display_text:
「No... that they'd been calling out to
each other.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: What's that supposed to mean?
rows.display_text: 「What's that supposed to mean?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: King Gainer and that black Overman--originally, only one of them was ever meant to exist.
rows.display_text:
「King Gainer and that black
Overman--originally, only one of them was
ever meant to exist.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Because that thing is King Gainer from another world.
rows.display_text:
「Because that thing is King Gainer from
another world.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Another world's...?
rows.display_text: 「Another world's...?」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: King Gainer...
rows.display_text: 「King Gainer...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Though to it, I suppose King Gainer is the one who's from another world...
rows.display_text:
「Though to it, I suppose King Gainer is
the one who's from another world...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What is this...? I can hear a voice in my head.
rows.display_text:
「What is this...? I can hear a voice in
my head.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Is that black Overman talking to us...!?
rows.display_text: 「Is that black Overman talking to us...!?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Did Gym Ghingnham hear this voice too...
rows.display_text:
「Did Gym Ghingnham hear this voice
too...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Whether humanity has meaning... is that what it's asking?
rows.display_text:
「Whether humanity has meaning... is that
what it's asking?」

rows.speaker: Lancerow
rows.en: Is that Overman posing the question to us...!?
rows.display_text:
「Is that Overman posing the question to
us...!?」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: The meaning of humanity... is it asking whether our existence is justified?
rows.display_text:
「The meaning of humanity... is it asking
whether our existence is justified?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Don't screw around! So you think humanity should just be wiped out!?
rows.display_text:
「Don't screw around! So you think
humanity should just be wiped out!?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: The Black Overman wants to know...
rows.display_text: 「The Black Overman wants to know...」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Whether human existence has any meaning to this planet...
rows.display_text:
「Whether human existence has any
meaning to this planet...」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: ...A reasonable question.
rows.display_text: 「...A reasonable question.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Lt. Quattro...
rows.display_text: 「Lt. Quattro...」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Creatures that not only hate each other, but wipe out other animals and pollute the Earth's environment...
rows.display_text:
「Creatures that hate each other, wipe
out other animals, and pollute the Earth's
environment...」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Such existence can only be harmful to the planet.
rows.display_text:
「Such existence can only be harmful to
the planet.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Is that your answer, Lieutenant?
rows.display_text: 「Is that your answer, Lieutenant?」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: ...I'm merely stating a fact.
rows.display_text: 「...I'm merely stating a fact.」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Is that why you're trying to destroy everything and remake the world anew...?
rows.display_text:
「Is that why you're trying to destroy
everything and remake the world anew...?」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: Now that the world has stabilized, will you fulfill your mission as the Executor System's ruler?
rows.display_text:
「Now that the world's stabilized, will
you fulfill your role as the Executor
System's ruler?」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: So you're saying the people of this planet failed, is that it!?
rows.display_text:
「So you're saying the people of this
planet failed, is that it!?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Answer me! Aren't we allowed to live!?
rows.display_text: 「Answer me! Aren't we allowed to live!?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Tell me! Are we creatures that deserve to be wiped out!?
rows.display_text:
「Tell me! Are we creatures that deserve
to be wiped out!?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: If you won't answer me, then I'll... I'll...!
rows.display_text:
「If you won't answer me, then I'll...
I'll...!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I'll find the answer myself!
rows.display_text: 「I'll find the answer myself!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: So you're saying you'll fight us no matter what...!?
rows.display_text:
「So you're saying you'll fight us no
matter what...!?」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: (Samurai... So you'll walk the path of carnage...)
rows.display_text:
（(Samurai... So you'll walk the path of
carnage...)）

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But we won't back down! For the sake of everyone!
rows.display_text:
「But we won't back down! For the sake
of everyone!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: If you're going to deny humanity, then we'll bring you down with human strength! To protect the future!
rows.display_text:
「Deny humanity, and we'll bring you down
with human strength -- to protect the
future!」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: That's our mission... $c's mission!
rows.display_text: 「That's our mission... $c's mission!」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: A method that smashes everything to bits ain't what I call a repair!
rows.display_text:
「A method that smashes everything to
bits ain't what I call a repair!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: We believe in humanity! For this beloved world and everyone in it, we'll fight you!
rows.display_text:
「We believe in humanity! For this beloved
world and everyone in it, we'll fight you!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: XAN... Zan... So that's your name.
rows.display_text: 「XAN... Zan... So that's your name.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I'll fight alongside King Gainer! For the humans you loved too!
rows.display_text:
「I'll fight alongside King Gainer! For the
humans you loved too!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Beyond the Black History, for the world of tomorrow!!
rows.display_text:
「Beyond the Black History, for the world
of tomorrow!!」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: We believe in humanity! For this beloved world and everyone in it, we'll fight you!
rows.display_text:
「We believe in humanity! For this beloved
world and everyone in it, we'll fight you!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: A method that smashes everything to bits ain't what I call a repair!
rows.display_text:
「A method that smashes everything to
bits ain't what I call a repair!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Instead of taking the easy way out like that, try believing in what people are capable of!
rows.display_text:
「Instead of taking the easy way out
like that, try believing in what people are
capable of!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Did we get it...!?
rows.display_text: 「Did we get it...!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: The Black Overman...!
rows.display_text: 「The Black Overman...!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: It vanished...
rows.display_text: 「It vanished...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Confirmed: all Executors have been wiped out.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed: all Executors have been
wiped out.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: So with the master, the Black Overman, gone, the system's shut down.
rows.display_text:
「So with the master, the Black Overman,
gone, the system's shut down.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: The unmanned units hiding all over the world have probably self-destructed as well.
rows.display_text:
「The unmanned units hiding all over the
world have probably self-destructed as
well.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Well done, everyone. The threat of the Executor System has passed.
rows.display_text:
「Well done, everyone. The threat of the
Executor System has passed.」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: So it's over...
rows.display_text: 「So it's over...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes...! The world's been saved!
rows.display_text: 「Yes...! The world's been saved!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: What's wrong, Gainer? Aren't you happy?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Gainer? Aren't you happy?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: At the very end, XAN said something to us...
rows.display_text:
「At the very end, XAN said something to
us...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: 'Thank you'... that's what it said.
rows.display_text: 「'Thank you'... that's what it said.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: You mean it thanked us?
rows.display_text: 「You mean it thanked us?」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: What's that supposed to mean?
rows.display_text: 「What's that supposed to mean?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: That Overman... it wanted us to defeat it...?
rows.display_text:
「That Overman... it wanted us to defeat
it...?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: ...I don't know. But I felt it while we were fighting.
rows.display_text:
「...I don't know. But I felt it while we
were fighting.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: XAN loved humanity from the bottom of its heart, and it was fighting for this world.
rows.display_text:
「XAN loved humanity from the bottom of
its heart, and it was fighting for this
world.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Maybe it was precisely because it loved humanity that it carried out its role as the Executor System's master...
rows.display_text:
「Maybe precisely because it loved
humanity, it carried out its role as the
Executor System's master...」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: That thing... was it really not our enemy after all?
rows.display_text:
「That thing... was it really not our
enemy after all?」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: But that system was built to destroy the world.
rows.display_text:
「But that system was built to destroy
the world.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: That's why I think it wanted someone... some human, to deny it.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I think it wanted someone...
some human, to deny it.」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: To find someone with the strength to deny the system and defeat it...
rows.display_text:
「To find someone with the strength to
deny the system and defeat it...」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: So that's why the Executors only targeted facilities...
rows.display_text:
「So that's why the Executors only
targeted facilities...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: And to do that, it waited... for a stretch of time so long it's dizzying...
rows.display_text:
「And to do that, it waited... for a
stretch of time so long it's dizzying...」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: ...It's all just guesswork. No use thinking about it.
rows.display_text:
「...It's all just guesswork. No use
thinking about it.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: But...

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: More importantly, now that we've denied it and taken it down, we've got work to do.
rows.display_text:
「More importantly, now that we've denied
it and taken it down, we've got work to
do.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: That's right. We declared that humanity would change through its own strength.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. We declared that humanity
would change through its own strength.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: We talked such a big game. If we don't follow through, we'll just be liars.
rows.display_text:
「We talked such a big game. If we don't
follow through, we'll just be liars.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Breach of contract goes against my policy too. I intend to keep my promise in good faith.
rows.display_text:
「Breach of contract goes against my
policy too. I intend to keep my promise
in good faith.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: I know. It's the world we live in... we've got to make it better with our own hands.
rows.display_text:
「I know. It's the world we live in...
we've got to make it better with our own
hands.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Yeah! That's our... no, the whole world's new fight now!
rows.display_text:
「Yeah! That's our... no, the whole
world's new fight now!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: This is a huge challenge. Makes my hands itch for it.
rows.display_text:
「This is a huge challenge. Makes my
hands itch for it.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Let's go, everyone...! Even once $c disbands here, we'll keep on fighting!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, everyone...! Even once $c
disbands here, we'll keep on fighting!」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Understood. I'll give it everything I've got.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. I'll give it everything I've
got.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: On Earth, in space... each of us fighting for what we believe in.
rows.display_text:
「On Earth, in space... each of us
fighting for what we believe in.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Everyone, hang in there! And let's meet again!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, hang in there! And let's meet
again!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Dawn's about to break... Beyond the Black History, a new era begins.
rows.display_text:
「Dawn's about to break... Beyond the
Black History, a new era begins.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (XAN... we'll keep fighting. To build a new era.)
rows.display_text:
（(XAN... we'll keep fighting. To build a
new era.)）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (I believe we'll get to meet again, too.)
rows.display_text:
（(I believe we'll get to meet again,
too.)）

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: See ya! If anything comes up, give the wandering repair shop Beater Service a call!
rows.display_text:
「See ya! If anything comes up, give the
wandering repair shop Beater Service a
call!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you, everyone. I hope with all my heart that we'll get to meet again someday.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, everyone. I hope with all my
heart that we'll get to meet again
someday.」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: Well then...
rows.display_text: 「Well then...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: It's over. The world's been saved.
rows.display_text: 「It's over. The world's been saved.」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: Thank you, everyone. I hope with all my heart that we'll get to meet again someday.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, everyone. I hope with all my
heart that we'll get to meet again
someday.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: See ya! If anything comes up, give the wandering repair shop Beater Service a call!
rows.display_text:
「See ya! If anything comes up, give the
wandering repair shop Beater Service a
call!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: What the--!? Our attacks aren't working at all!
rows.display_text:
「What the--!? Our attacks aren't
working at all!」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: That's a Photon Mat on a whole different level! Almost no damage is getting through!
rows.display_text:
「That's a Photon Mat on a whole
different level! Almost no damage is
getting through!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: So its Overskill is off the charts too...! This one's tough!
rows.display_text:
「So its Overskill is off the charts
too...! This one's tough!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: But if we don't defeat XAN, the world will have to keep fearing the Black History forever...!
rows.display_text:
「If we don't defeat XAN, the world will
have to keep fearing the Black History
forever...!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That's why we can't afford to lose! I've had enough of being bound by the past!!
rows.display_text:
「That's why we can't afford to lose!
I've had enough of being bound by the
past!!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: I've met plenty of good people and bad people alike, up till now...
rows.display_text:
「I've met plenty of good people and bad
people alike, up till now...」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Every single person is different! It's crazy to lump them all together and wipe them out!
rows.display_text:
「Every single person is different! It's
crazy to lump them all together and wipe
them out!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: That's why we protect humanity! And on top of that, we keep fighting the bad ones!
rows.display_text:
「That's why we protect humanity! And on
top of that, we keep fighting the bad
ones!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: We know that the long, drawn-out war became the era known as the Black History.
rows.display_text:
「We know that the long, drawn-out war
became the era known as the Black
History.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: After being shown all that, I guess it's no wonder someone would give up on humanity...
rows.display_text:
「After being shown all that, I guess it's
no wonder someone would give up on
humanity...」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: But we've fought to keep that from becoming our history! We won't let it end here!
rows.display_text:
「But we've fought to keep that from
becoming our history! We won't let it end
here!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: Humans have hearts that love and cherish this beautiful planet.
rows.display_text:
「Humans have hearts that love and
cherish this beautiful planet.」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: Is it because you have that same heart that you're trying to destroy humanity?
rows.display_text:
「Is it because you have that same heart
that you're trying to destroy humanity?」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: If that's true, I don't want to fight you...! We should be able to understand each other!
rows.display_text:
「If that's true, I don't want to fight
you...! We should be able to understand
each other!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: But if you won't stop the system, I won't hesitate to fight! For the sake of this planet we love!
rows.display_text:
「But if you won't stop the system, I
won't hesitate to fight -- for this
planet we love!」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: Sleeping all this time just waiting for the day you'd wipe out humanity from the Earth-- that's real dedication!
rows.display_text:
「Sleeping all this time, just waiting to
wipe out humanity from the Earth --
that's real dedication!」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: Whoever built a system like this must not have trusted people one bit.
rows.display_text:
「Whoever built a system like this must
not have trusted people one bit.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: But we're different! We believe in humanity's potential! That's why we can fight like this!
rows.display_text:
「But we're different -- we believe in
humanity's potential! That's why we fight
like this!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: If you can hear our voices, then stop fighting! Humans can change the world!!
rows.display_text:
「If you can hear our voices, then stop
fighting! Humans can change the world!!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: You stubborn Overman! Why won't you listen to a word we say!?
rows.display_text:
「You stubborn Overman! Why won't you
listen to a word we say!?」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: Humans won't do something like destroy this planet!
rows.display_text:
「Humans won't do something like destroy
this planet!」

rows.speaker: Uchuta
rows.en: Sure, there are bad people out there too...!
rows.display_text:
「Sure, there are bad people out there
too...!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: If someone like that shows up, we'll fight them! So stop the system already!
rows.display_text:
「If someone like that shows up, we'll
fight them! So stop the system already!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: A peaceful, prosperous Earth is something people will work hard to build!!
rows.display_text:
「A peaceful, prosperous Earth is
something people will work hard to build!!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Black Overman... You have a heart. So why do something this heartless?
rows.display_text:
「Black Overman... You have a heart. So
why do something this heartless?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: You've no intention of answering... or are you deliberately choosing not to?
rows.display_text:
「You've no intention of answering... or
are you deliberately choosing not to?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Very well...! If that's how you want it, we'll fight! As our answer to the Executor!
rows.display_text:
「Very well...! If that's how you want it,
we'll fight! As our answer to the
Executor!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: For the world, for its people-- Daitarn 3, smashing the Black History!
rows.display_text:
「For the world, for its people-- Daitarn
3, smashing the Black History!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: If you don't fear the brilliance of this sun disc, then come at me!!
rows.display_text:
「If you don't fear the brilliance of this
sun disc, then come at me!!」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: That's enough! No matter what the people of the Black History say, we love this planet too!
rows.display_text:
「That's enough! Whatever the people of
the Black History say, we love this planet
too!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: You don't need destruction. If humanity pools its wisdom, we can heal this wounded planet!
rows.display_text:
「You don't need destruction. If humanity
pools its wisdom, we can heal this
wounded planet!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: We will never accept a method that takes human lives!
rows.display_text:
「We will never accept a method that
takes human lives!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Try believing in people a little more! Human potential is far bigger than you think!
rows.display_text:
「Try believing in people a little more!
Human potential is far bigger than you
think!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: Please, stop...! I want to talk with you!
rows.display_text: 「Please, stop...! I want to talk with you!」

rows.speaker: Raita
rows.en: What are you saying, Marin!?
rows.display_text: 「What are you saying, Marin!?」

rows.speaker: Oliver
rows.en: Wait, Raita. Listen to what Marin has to say.
rows.display_text:
「Wait, Raita. Listen to what Marin has
to say.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: The humans who made the Executors, and you-- you both love the Earth... We feel the same way.
rows.display_text:
「Those who made the Executors, and you
-- you both love the Earth. We feel the
same.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: And human life is just as irreplaceable as the Earth itself.
rows.display_text:
「And human life is just as irreplaceable
as the Earth itself.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: If you love the Earth, then love its people the same way!
rows.display_text:
「If you love the Earth, then love its
people the same way!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: ...You won't answer me... Then I'll make up my mind too...
rows.display_text:
「...You won't answer me... Then I'll make
up my mind too...」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: Here I come, Black Overman! For the sake of Earth and humanity's tomorrow, I'll strike you down!!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, Black Overman! For Earth
and humanity's tomorrow, I'll strike you
down!!」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Listen up, Black Overman! People are amazing, you know!
rows.display_text:
「Listen up, Black Overman! People are
amazing, you know!」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: Not everyone's a good person, but of course, not everyone's a bad one either.
rows.display_text:
「Not everyone's a good person, but of
course, not everyone's a bad one either.」

rows.speaker: Leele
rows.en: There are plenty of kind-hearted people in this world.
rows.display_text:
「There are plenty of kind-hearted people
in this world.」

rows.speaker: Eina
rows.en: As long as people like that exist, the world is sure to keep getting better!
rows.display_text:
「As long as people like that exist, the
world is sure to keep getting better!」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Is it okay to destroy even people like that!? That's just wrong!
rows.display_text:
「Is it okay to destroy even people like
that!? That's just wrong!」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: If you've got a heart too, you should understand, right!? You're still gonna do it anyway!?
rows.display_text:
「If you've got a heart too, you'd
understand, right!? You're still doing it
anyway!?」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: If fighting as the Executor is your mission, then our mission is to bring you down...!
rows.display_text:
「If fighting as the Executor is your
mission, then our mission is to bring you
down...!」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: We will fight! As the Gran Knights... as humans living on this planet!!
rows.display_text:
「We will fight! As the Gran Knights... as
humans living on this planet!!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: You listening to us, pitch-black bastard!?
rows.display_text:
「You listening to us, pitch-black
bastard!?」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Stop fighting, and stop the system! You have a heart too, don't you!?
rows.display_text:
「Stop fighting, and stop the system! You
have a heart too, don't you!?」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: That's right! A method like this is just wrong!
rows.display_text:
「That's right! A method like this is just
wrong!」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Humans are creatures of this planet too! There's no way it's right to destroy them!
rows.display_text:
「Humans are creatures of this planet
too! There's no way it's right to destroy
them!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Aren't our words reaching you at all...!?
rows.display_text: 「Aren't our words reaching you at all...!?」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: Is this guy just another self-centered jerk who won't listen either!?
rows.display_text:
「Is this guy just another self-centered
jerk who won't listen either!?」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: (That's not it...)
rows.display_text: （(That's not it...)）

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: Black Overman... If you won't back down, then we will strike you down...
rows.display_text:
「Black Overman... If you won't back
down, then we will strike you down...」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: For the sake of the world and the people we believe in!
rows.display_text:
「For the sake of the world and the
people we believe in!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: We're alive on this planet! Like hell we'll do whatever some ghost of the past tells us!!
rows.display_text:
「We're alive on this planet! No way we'll
obey some ghost of the past!!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The color black holds meaning.
rows.display_text: 「The color black holds meaning.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Roger...?
rows.display_text: 「Roger...?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: A deep black that swallows everything up... It hides even one's own heart.
rows.display_text:
「A deep black that swallows everything
up... It hides even one's own heart.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Put another way, hidden within it is a strong will that no one can violate.
rows.display_text:
「Put another way, hidden within it is a
strong will that no one can violate.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Is that true of you too?
rows.display_text: 「Is that true of you too?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Questioning him would be pointless. His will doesn't waver. ...There's only one way to answer that.
rows.display_text:
「Questioning him is pointless -- his will
won't waver. There's only one way to
answer that.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Black Overman...! I'll oblige you, just as you wish!
rows.display_text:
「Black Overman...! I'll oblige you, just as
you wish!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I haven't given up on this thing called humanity either!
rows.display_text:
「I haven't given up on this thing called
humanity either!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: That thing...
rows.display_text: 「That thing...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: There's hostility, but not malice...? Does he actually believe in what he's doing...!?
rows.display_text:
「There's hostility, but not malice...?
Does he actually believe in what he's
doing...!?」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: If we hesitate, we'll be taken down...! He hasn't got a shred of doubt!
rows.display_text:
「If we hesitate, we'll be taken down...!
He hasn't got a shred of doubt!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: We can't afford to lose! We've fought until today believing in the world... in people!!
rows.display_text:
「We can't afford to lose! We've fought
until today believing in the world... in
people!!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Posing that question to me again... But I've already given my answer.
rows.display_text:
「Posing that question to me again... But
I've already given my answer.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: A conviction without a shred of doubt. So that's the source of your strength...
rows.display_text:
「A conviction without a shred of doubt.
So that's the source of your strength...」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: But I won't back down either. Even while doubting, I intend to move forward with this world...
rows.display_text:
「But I won't back down either -- even
doubting, I'll move forward with this
world...」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Betting on humanity's potential...!
rows.display_text: 「Betting on humanity's potential...!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Looking at the big picture, your way of thinking might even be right...
rows.display_text:
「Looking at the big picture, your way of
thinking might even be right...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: But I deny it...! The Executor System's methods are nothing but slaughter!
rows.display_text:
「But I deny it...! The Executor System's
methods are nothing but slaughter!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: How can you do something like this while having a heart...!?
rows.display_text:
「How can you do something like this
while having a heart...!?」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: This feeling... don't tell me...!
rows.display_text: 「This feeling... don't tell me...!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Even though I understand you now... no, precisely because I understand, we have to bring you down!
rows.display_text:
「Even understanding you now -- no,
precisely because I understand, we have
to bring you down!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: To show you the meaning of humanity you're looking for... its potential!
rows.display_text:
「To show you the meaning of humanity
you're looking for... its potential!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: It was you who asked Gym Ghingnham about the meaning of humanity, wasn't it?
rows.display_text:
「It was you who asked Gym Ghingnham
about the meaning of humanity, wasn't it?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Our answer is different from that man's. ...The meaning of being human isn't fighting. I think just living is the meaning itself.
rows.display_text:
「Our answer differs from his. Being
human isn't about fighting -- just living
is the meaning itself.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: It's only when someone comes to take that away that people finally fight.
rows.display_text:
「It's only when someone comes to take
that away that people finally fight.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: If you're going to destroy things to protect this planet, then I'll fight you. To protect lives... to protect people.
rows.display_text:
「If you'll destroy things to protect this
planet, I'll fight you -- to protect lives,
to protect people.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: People will go on living on this planet! You can't take that away from them!
rows.display_text:
「People will go on living on this planet!
You can't take that away from them!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I've had enough of your logic...! I don't want to watch human lives get lost anymore!!
rows.display_text:
「I've had enough of your logic...! I don't
want to watch human lives get lost
anymore!!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Even the people who built the Executor System must have watched the people around them die too...
rows.display_text:
「Even those who built the Executor
System must've watched people around
them die too...」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: So why did they leave something like this behind for future generations!?
rows.display_text:
「So why did they leave something like
this behind for future generations!?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I will never accept it! This planet doesn't need destruction for the sake of rebirth!!
rows.display_text:
「I will never accept it! This planet
doesn't need destruction for the sake of
rebirth!!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: For the sake of everyone who's fought believing in the future, I'll defeat you!!
rows.display_text:
「For the sake of everyone who's fought
believing in the future, I'll defeat you!!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: I think I get it, somehow... That you have your own resolve too.
rows.display_text:
「I think I get it, somehow... That you
have your own resolve too.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: That's why you don't waver. Because you believe in what you're doing.
rows.display_text:
「That's why you don't waver. Because
you believe in what you're doing.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: But that's the same for me too. I've made up my mind, and that's why I'm fighting like this.
rows.display_text:
「That's the same for me too. I've made
up my mind, and that's why I'm fighting
like this.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: So I won't back down...! I'll fight for this world and the people who live in it!
rows.display_text:
「So I won't back down...! I'll fight for
this world and the people who live in it!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Because that's what I've chosen to believe in!
rows.display_text:
「Because that's what I've chosen to
believe in!」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Wait, Garrod...! He's...
rows.display_text: 「Wait, Garrod...! He's...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: What's wrong, Tiffa!? Did something happen!?
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong, Tiffa!? Did something
happen!?」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: I-it's nothing... Be careful...
rows.display_text: 「I-it's nothing... Be careful...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Yeah! There's no way we're losing! We can't afford to lose!
rows.display_text:
「Yeah! There's no way we're losing! We
can't afford to lose!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: We're gonna show this ghost of the Black History that people and the world can still change!
rows.display_text:
「We'll show this ghost of the Black
History that people and the world can
still change!」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: (XAN... is that what you want...?)
rows.display_text: （(XAN... is that what you want...?)）

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Here we come, Black Overman! There's no way we're giving up! Not on the world, not on the future!
rows.display_text:
「Here we come, Black Overman! There's no
way we're giving up -- not on the world,
not on the future!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: This is the strength of humanity you people denied!!
rows.display_text:
「This is the strength of humanity you
people denied!!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Black Overman... You have a heart, so why do you cling to a system from the past...!?
rows.display_text:
「Black Overman... You have a heart, so
why do you cling to a system from the
past...!?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Even I, who's lost my Newtype powers, can tell. There's a strong will inside you.
rows.display_text:
「Even I, who's lost my Newtype powers,
can tell. There's a strong will inside you.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Then I will fight you...! Because I too carry a will just as strong as yours!
rows.display_text:
「Then I will fight you...! Because I too
carry a will just as strong as yours!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: I believe in humanity's future! From those fifteen years ago, right up to this very moment!
rows.display_text:
「I believe in humanity's future! From
those fifteen years ago to this very
moment!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Can you hear me, Black? If you've got a heart, then listen to what I've got to say.
rows.display_text:
「Can you hear me, Black? If you've got
a heart, then listen to what I've got to
say.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: I'm about to become a father. I'm getting a family.
rows.display_text:
「I'm about to become a father. I'm
getting a family.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: ...Kinda makes you laugh, huh?
rows.display_text: 「...Kinda makes you laugh, huh?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Me, who killed my mother just by being born, and let my brother--who killed my father--die without lifting a finger... I'm getting a family.
rows.display_text:
「Killed my mother being born, let the
brother who killed my father die and did
nothing... and now I'm getting a family.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: But... damn it, I'm happy about it. I feel like this is the first time I've realized just how dazzling life can be.
rows.display_text:
「But damn it, I'm happy. Feels like the
first time I've realized how dazzling life
can be.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: I don't know what kind of person my kid's gonna grow up to be... Maybe they'll turn into some huge villain.
rows.display_text:
「I don't know what kind of person my
kid'll grow up to be... Maybe some huge
villain.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: But damn it...! If a life gets condemned before it's even born, there's nothing anyone can do about it!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it...! If a life's condemned before
it's even born, there's nothing anyone can
do!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Every life that's ever born is the same! If you're gonna deny the future, then I'll be the one to face you!
rows.display_text:
「Every life ever born is the same! Deny
the future, and I'll be the one to face
you!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: On behalf of every father living in this world!!
rows.display_text:
「On behalf of every father living in this
world!!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Listen to me, Black Overman!
rows.display_text: 「Listen to me, Black Overman!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: I... I changed after meeting Renton...! I was able to change!
rows.display_text:
「I... I changed after meeting Renton...! I
was able to change!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: But! If you destroy the world, that kind of possibility disappears completely!
rows.display_text:
「But! If you destroy the world, that
kind of possibility disappears completely!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: That can't be allowed...! Everyone can change... they can make the world better!
rows.display_text:
「That can't be allowed...! Everyone can
change... they can make the world better!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: That's why we're going to stop the Executor System! Because we believe in humanity!
rows.display_text:
「That's why we're going to stop the
Executor System! Because we believe in
humanity!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Let's go, Renton...! For our world and the people we love!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, Renton...! For our world and
the people we love!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Gramps...! And Maurice, Maetel, Linck too! Wait for us!
rows.display_text:
「Gramps...! And Maurice, Maetel, Linck
too! Wait for us!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: We're... definitely going to protect this planet's future and come back to everyone!!
rows.display_text:
「We're... definitely going to protect this
planet's future and come back to
everyone!!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Hey, Black Overman! What you're doing is no different from the Innocents' rule!
rows.display_text:
「Hey, Black Overman! What you're doing
is no different from the Innocents' rule!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: I've had enough of being bound by some selfish rule decided ages ago, without even understanding why!
rows.display_text:
「I've had enough of being bound by some
selfish rule set ages ago, without even
knowing why!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: This era belongs to the people living in it now! Now crawl back into your hole quietly!
rows.display_text:
「This era belongs to the people living in
it now! Now crawl back into your hole
quietly!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: You're really gonna go through with this!? You stubborn rock-head!
rows.display_text:
「You're really gonna go through with
this!? You stubborn rock-head!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Then I'm not backing down either! I believe in humanity too!
rows.display_text:
「Then I'm not backing down either! I
believe in humanity too!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Here I come! We don't need the Black History anymore!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come! We don't need the Black
History anymore!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: XAN... you're really saying you'll fight no matter what?
rows.display_text:
「XAN... you're really saying you'll fight
no matter what?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Tell me the reason! You love this planet and its people too, don't you!?
rows.display_text:
「Tell me the reason! You love this
planet and its people too, don't you!?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: It comes through King Gainer! That you have a righteous heart!
rows.display_text:
「It comes through King Gainer! That you
have a righteous heart!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: If you're still saying you'll fight, then I'll throw away my doubts...!
rows.display_text:
「If you're still saying you'll fight, then
I'll throw away my doubts...!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: And I'll fight alongside King Gainer! For the future of this planet and humanity!
rows.display_text:
「And I'll fight alongside King Gainer! For
the future of this planet and humanity!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: King Gainer! If Overskill means surpassing yourself, then you're coming with me!
rows.display_text:
「King Gainer! If Overskill means
surpassing yourself, then you're coming
with me!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: You too--surpass yourself... surpass XAN! If you love this planet!!
rows.display_text:
「You too--surpass yourself... surpass
XAN! If you love this planet!!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Brunnhilde's arm is trembling. Seems like it's on edge about facing you.
rows.display_text:
「Brunnhilde's arm is trembling. Seems like
it's on edge about facing you.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Think it over. You're not the same as the Overdevil, are you?
rows.display_text:
「Think it over. You're not the same as
the Overdevil, are you?」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Or are you doing all this fully convinced of it?
rows.display_text:
「Or are you doing all this fully
convinced of it?」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Then no more holding back. I'll take you on just the way you want.
rows.display_text:
「Then no more holding back. I'll take you
on just the way you want.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: For the world, for humanity... and above all, for my own life!
rows.display_text:
「For the world, for humanity... and above
all, for my own life!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: A new era's finally coming, and here's some relic from ancient times causing trouble.
rows.display_text:
「A new era's finally coming, and here's
some relic from ancient times causing
trouble.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Sorry, Black Samurai... For the sake of my adorable baby, I'm not letting myself or this world end here.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, Black Samurai... For my adorable
baby's sake, I won't let myself or this
world end here.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: ...Honestly, when I first learned what the Singularity's role was, I almost went off the deep end myself.
rows.display_text:
「...Honestly, learning the Singularity's
role, I almost went off the deep end
myself.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Thinking, if I don't like someone, they should just disappear...
rows.display_text:
「Thinking, if I don't like someone, they
should just disappear...」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: But nobody has the right to do that.
rows.display_text: 「But nobody has the right to do that.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: This isn't about winning or losing a war. It's just wrong for anyone to decide someone else's future...!
rows.display_text:
「This isn't about winning or losing a
war. It's just wrong for anyone to decide
another's future...!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: That's why I'll fight you! For a world where people can decide their own future!
rows.display_text:
「That's why I'll fight you! For a world
where people can decide their own future!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Did the person who built the Executor System give up on humanity...?
rows.display_text:
「Did the person who built the Executor
System give up on humanity...?」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: So they thought they'd just thin out humanity and restore Earth's environment that way!?
rows.display_text:
「So they thought they'd just thin out
humanity and restore Earth's environment
that way!?」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Hmph... when pessimism flips over, people come up with the boldest things.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... when pessimism flips over, people
come up with the boldest things.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Please, listen...! There's no need for destruction just to bring about rebirth!
rows.display_text:
「Please, listen...! There's no need for
destruction just to bring about rebirth!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: What's lost doesn't come back! What's lost to destruction... human lives, don't come back!
rows.display_text:
「What's lost doesn't come back! What's
lost to destruction... human lives, don't
come back!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I refuse to accept a world reborn out of that kind of grief and pain!
rows.display_text:
「I refuse to accept a world reborn out
of that kind of grief and pain!」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: The ensign's right. The Executor System's methods are nothing but a cold cutting-away.
rows.display_text:
「The ensign's right. The Executor
System's methods are nothing but a cold
cutting-away.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: People can manage just fine without relying on some easy way out like that...!
rows.display_text:
「People can manage just fine without
relying on some easy way out like that...!」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Look at us. We started off all prickly with each other, but somehow we've turned into a real team, haven't we?
rows.display_text:
「Look at us. We started off prickly with
each other, but somehow became a real
team, huh?」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: It's the result of us trying to understand each other, meeting halfway, and building trust. Humans are capable of that.
rows.display_text:
「It's from trying to understand each
other, meeting halfway, building trust.
Humans can do that.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I believe in humanity's potential. That is exactly what it means to live...!
rows.display_text:
「I believe in humanity's potential. That
is exactly what it means to live...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's why I'll fight you! Protecting the world and its people--that's the Glory Star's fight!
rows.display_text:
「That's why I fight you! Protecting the
world and its people is the Glory Star's
fight!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Destruction and rebirth, huh...! You take things way too far!
rows.display_text:
「Destruction and rebirth, huh...! You
take things way too far!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: But didn't Darling say something like that during the last fight too?
rows.display_text:
「But didn't Darling say something like
that during the last fight too?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: T-that's, uh...! In my case it's more like... measured destruction...
rows.display_text:
「T-that's, uh...! In my case it's more
like... measured destruction...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Don't give me that look! Sure, I'm a repairman, but I've done my share of smashing too!
rows.display_text:
「Don't give me that look! Sure, I'm a
repairman, but I've done my share of
smashing too!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But that's only when there's no hope of fixing it!
rows.display_text:
「But that's only when there's no hope
of fixing it!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's right. People haven't rotted through that badly. So we don't need any destruction.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. People haven't rotted
through that badly. So we don't need any
destruction.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But still! There oughta be at least a chance to make up for a mistake!
rows.display_text:
「But still! There oughta be at least a
chance to make up for a mistake!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Are they communicating just through eye contact...!?
rows.display_text:
「Are they communicating just through
eye contact...!?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's why I never give up! As long as it can be fixed, I'll fix it properly!
rows.display_text:
「That's why I never give up! As long as
it can be fixed, I'll fix it properly!」

rows.en: If you throw something out the second it breaks, you can't call yourself a repairman!
rows.display_text:

it breaks, you can't call yourself a
repairman!」

rows.en: Come on then! With the future on the line, your stubbornness against my pride, head-on!!

line, your stubbornness against my pride,
head-on!!」

rows.display_text:
「Come on then! With the future on the

head-on!!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: You too, just like me, love this planet, and waited a long age for the sake of your own mission...
rows.display_text:
「You too, like me, love this planet, and
waited a long age for your own mission's
sake...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: I'll pay my respects to that conviction...!
rows.display_text:
「I'll pay my respects to that
conviction...!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: And now, for what each of us believes in, let this fated duel begin!
rows.display_text:
「And now, for what each of us believes
in, let this fated duel begin!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Shinn...
rows.display_text: 「Shinn...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: That's right. That answer is something we ourselves... something humanity decides for itself.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. That's something we
ourselves -- something humanity decides
for itself.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Listen up, Black Overman! Just being alive means something, all on its own!
rows.display_text:
「Listen up, Black Overman! Just being
alive means something, all on its own!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Sure, humanity might be foolish, but that doesn't mean we'll let ourselves be wiped out without even understanding why...!
rows.display_text:
「Humanity may be foolish, but that's no
reason to wipe us out without even
knowing why...!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: People are alive in this world! Living today with everything they've got!
rows.display_text:
「People are alive in this world! Living
today with everything they've got!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: It's not just good people out there--there are bad ones too, but that's part of the world as well!
rows.display_text:
「Not everyone's good -- there are bad
ones too, but that's part of the world as
well!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: The world's still got its whole future ahead of it. It'd be a waste to end it here.
rows.display_text:
「The world's still got its whole future
ahead of it. It'd be a waste to end it
here.」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: It's people who make people better too. Cutting off that potential is the same as sealing the future in darkness!
rows.display_text:
「People make people better too. Cutting
off that potential seals the future in
darkness!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: Polluting nature is a sin humans committed. But it's those same humans who act to make up for it.
rows.display_text:
「Polluting nature was humanity's sin --
but it's those same humans who act to
make up for it.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: If we get wiped out, we can't apologize, we can't start over, we can't do anything at all!
rows.display_text:
「If we're wiped out, we can't apologize,
start over, or do anything at all!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: So we won't repeat our mistakes, people work hard and keep on living! Are you saying you won't even acknowledge that!?
rows.display_text:
「We won't repeat our mistakes -- people
work hard and keep living! Won't you even
admit that!?」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Lieutenant... you must have fought until today because you believe in humanity's future too.
rows.display_text:
「Lieutenant... you must've fought till
today because you believe in humanity's
future too.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Amuro...
rows.display_text: 「Amuro...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: If you think humanity's foolish, then change it with humanity's own strength. That's what it means to create the future.
rows.display_text:
「If humanity's foolish, change it with
humanity's own strength. That's what
creates the future.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: You're right.
rows.display_text: 「You're right.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: The answer we've reached is just as you've heard, Executor.
rows.display_text:
「The answer we've reached is just as
you've heard, Executor.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: So, I'll take the liberty of denying your mission.
rows.display_text:
「So, I'll take the liberty of denying
your mission.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: We believe in humanity! That's why we can fight like this!
rows.display_text:
「We believe in humanity! That's why we
can fight like this!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Please understand! People can still fly!
rows.display_text: 「Please understand! People can still fly!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: ...Then, Martina, while you were frozen inside the Agato Crystal, did you touch the Overdevil's will?
rows.display_text:
「...Martina, while frozen inside the Agato
Crystal, did you touch the Overdevil's
will?」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: Whether that voice was really the Overdevil's, I couldn't say. I was somewhere between dreaming and waking, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Whether that voice was really the
Overdevil's, I can't say. I was somewhere
between dream and waking.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: But I sure did hear it... no--I touched it. Memories from the age that ice devil was born into...
rows.display_text:
「But I did hear it... no -- I touched it.
Memories from the age that ice devil was
born into...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Tell us, Martina Lane. About that devil of an Overman.
rows.display_text:
「Tell us, Martina Lane. About that devil
of an Overman.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: I doubt that thing was ever called a devil from the very start.
rows.display_text:
「I doubt that thing was ever called a
devil from the very start.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: It must have been built as humanity's strength, to fight enemies like the Shadow Angels, after all.
rows.display_text:
「It must've been built as humanity's
strength, to fight enemies like the
Shadow Angels, after all.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: But didn't the Overdevil try to freeze the whole world in ice?
rows.display_text:
「But didn't the Overdevil try to freeze
the whole world in ice?」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: Something got twisted along the way. I'd wager it's the same story for that White Mustache mechanical doll too.
rows.display_text:
「Something got twisted along the way --
probably the same for that White
Mustache mechanical doll too.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: The end of the Black History changed everything.
rows.display_text:
「The end of the Black History changed
everything.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: The great cataclysm... meaning a rupture of space-time... I've heard a spacetime quake on the scale of the Break the World occurred.
rows.display_text:
「The great cataclysm -- a rupture of
space-time. I've heard it was a Break the
World-scale quake.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: The terror of that moment must have changed people, and as a result, both White Mustache and the Overdevil were turned into devils, I'd guess.
rows.display_text:
「That terror must've changed people --
turning both White Mustache and the
Overdevil into devils, I'd guess.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: With the enemy it was meant to fight gone, its power got used to remake the world instead.
rows.display_text:
「With its intended enemy gone, its power
got used to remake the world instead.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Overfreeze and the Moonlight Butterfly, you mean.
rows.display_text:
「Overfreeze and the Moonlight Butterfly,
you mean.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: People wanted to forget their fear... So they tried to reduce everything to nothing, just once.
rows.display_text:
「People wanted to forget their fear... so
they tried to wipe out everything, just
once.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: After that, the people who remained moved their lives to the moon and to space, and decided to wait for the environment to recover...
rows.display_text:
「After that, survivors moved to the
moon and space, deciding to wait for the
environment to recover...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: And so the White Mustache mechanical doll, its role finished, went to sleep?
rows.display_text:

doll, its role finished, went to sleep?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Then what about the Overdevil that Kizz Munt had? Did it put itself to sleep as well?
rows.display_text:

Kizz Munt had? Did it put itself to sleep
as well?」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: That one was special. It had slipped its control and gone completely berserk.
rows.display_text:

control and gone completely berserk.」

rows.speaker: Martina

rows.display_text:
「It was the Overman with the head of
hair that sealed it away in the Agato
Crystal.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: King Gainer, you mean...!?
rows.display_text: 「King Gainer, you mean...!?」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: It's true, that Overman closely resembles the one held in the Overdevil's memory.
rows.display_text:
「It's true, that Overman closely
resembles the one held in the Overdevil's
memory.」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: But the color's different. The one that sealed away the Overdevil was a black Overman.
rows.display_text:
「But the color's different. The one that
sealed away the Overdevil was a black
Overman.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: A black Overman...
rows.display_text: 「A black Overman...」

rows.speaker: Martina
rows.en: That's right... An Overman with a pure soul, one that loved the righteousness in human hearts.
rows.display_text:
「That's right... An Overman with a pure
soul that loved the righteousness in
human hearts.」
